title: use-after-free on borrowed dict key in json encoder
live_proof: NOT a backport. Fixed on main, never back-ported; the apply test fails because the function was renamed. Live by inspection: Modules/_json.c:1621 of v3.13.7 hands the borrowed key and value to encoder_encode_key_value with no Py_INCREF at all
lifetime_ender: the default callback clears the dict, freeing every entry
